protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. The seven pre-fix OSPF TE/SR parsers accumulate uint32_t TLV_SIZE() values in uint16_t sum/len variables while advancing with TLV_HDR_NEXT(). For a wire length of 65535, ROUNDUP(..., 4) is 65536 and TLV_SIZE() is 65540, which truncates to 4 in uint16_t and permits pointer advancement beyond the LSA buffer.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as cf9b9f77f638923f5a44fdd14ce2725631ffa526. Its new ospfd/ospf_sr.c first writes get_ext_link_sid, get_ext_prefix_sid, and ospf_sr_ri_lsa_update with the vulnerable 16-bit accounting. Path-following -S history terminates at this commit. The four TE functions are later same-mechanism copies first written by f173deb35206a09e8dc22828cb08638e289b72a5, not an earlier origin.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The single immediate parent is b782607f7f2125dd0e5789d5744cc97baf03b0e6; its tree has no ospfd/ospf_sr.c and repository grep finds none of get_ext_link_sid, get_ext_prefix_sid, or ospf_sr_ri_lsa_update.
